fusions.name: Mudbank Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges at a target up to 5 tiles away for 26 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit, and it leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolling Clamp
fusions.desc: Clamps onto the target and twists the blade: deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Still Water
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you 70% later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

fusions.name: Won't Let Go
fusions.desc: Against enemies below 50% health, you deal 12% more damage.
